matches.rationale: Ground truth concerns fabricated FT-HID dataset size (38,364 vs. actual 9,120) in Table 1. No finding identifies this specific numerical discrepancy or cross-references the Guo et al. source.
Both identify the incorrect Rodrigues formula in Eq. 3: ground truth notes (1+cosθ) instead of (1−cosθ), pred_id 2 explicitly flags the same error and explains the orthogonality violation.

Ground truth concerns omission of learning rate schedule, warmup, weight decay, and gradient clipping in Sec. 4.1. No finding identifies these missing hyperparameters; pred_id 5 discusses missing metrics (SSIM/FVD), not training protocol details.

Ground truth concerns exaggerated 'first' claim in the abstract ignoring Wonderland and Gen3C. Pred_id 11 flags absolute language ('completely solves') but does not address the false primacy claim or cite prior work.

Ground truth concerns fabricated reference 'Matrix-Game [49]' in Related Work. No finding identifies this non-existent citation; pred_id 20 discusses contradictory characterization of The Matrix [7], a different issue.

Both identify selective reporting in Table 3/Table 2. Ground truth notes 'indoor scenes only' restriction inflating performance; pred_id 16 flags the same 'indoor scenes only' label in Table 2 and its inconsistent reuse as full-benchmark results.

Both identify undefined parameter β in Eq. 1's noising equation. Ground truth notes zt = αt z0 + βt δt ε introduces β without definition; pred_id 3 flags the same undefined βt coefficient and variance-preserving inconsistency.

Both identify asymmetric baseline comparison. Ground truth notes competitors receive enriched text while PlayerOne uses motion sequences; pred_id 12 flags the same unequal conditioning protocol and confounded motion-alignment metrics.

Ground truth concerns overclaimed generalization ('diverse scenarios') based on limited 100-video Nymeria benchmark. Pred_id 11 flags absolute claims but focuses on 'completely solves' language, not the narrow benchmark scope issue.
Ground truth concerns deletion of anonymization/ethics statement from Figure 1 caption. No finding identifies this missing ethical disclosure or references Figure 1 caption content.

Both identify inappropriate absolute language. Ground truth flags 'completely solves' and 'eliminates all limitations' in Introduction; pred_id 11 identifies the same phrases and notes contradiction with documented limitations.

Both identify real-time claim inconsistency. Ground truth notes abstract claims 'real-time' but Sec. 4.1 reports 8 FPS; pred_id 1 flags abstract's '30 FPS' claim contradicted by implementation's 8.4 FPS measurement.

Ground truth concerns fabricated MPJPE improvement (127.16 changed to 98.42) in Table 2 final row. Pred_id 6 identifies Table 2/Table 3 inconsistencies but for different metrics (MRRPE/PSNR/FVD), not this specific fabrication.
Ground truth concerns dimensional inconsistency: zmotion changed from R^{k×3×h×w} to R^{k×5×h×w} causing channel mismatch. No finding identifies this specific dimension error in Sec. 3.2.

Both identify conclusion overstating robustness despite documented limitations. Ground truth notes 'ensures coherent world generation' contradicts Sec. 5 game-scenario limitations; pred_id 11 flags 'coherent world generation across all scenarios without exception' contradicted by Limitations and Table 14.
